heroTitle: Find the format that fits you
heroSubtitle: Whether you want one-on-one attention or a fun morning on the court with friends, there's a lesson format built for you.

formats.title: Private Lessons
formats.description: One-on-one coaching built entirely around your game. Ideal if you want fast progress or have specific things to work on.

formats.title: Semi-Private (2 players)
formats.description: Bring a friend, spouse, or doubles partner. Great for working on chemistry and communication as a team.
checklist: Split the cost with a partner

formats.title: Group Clinics
formats.description: Small groups of 3–4 players, with per-person rates that get better as your group grows. Great for friend groups working on the same skills together.

skillLevelsHeading: Whatever your skill level, we'll meet you there

skillLevels.title: New to Pickleball
skillLevels.description: Learn the rules, the basic shots, and court positioning in a relaxed, no-pressure setting. No athletic background needed.

skillLevels.title: Casual Player
skillLevels.description: You've been playing for a while and want to move beyond the basics — better consistency, smarter shot selection, and real strategy.

skillLevels.title: Competitive Player
skillLevels.description: Preparing for league play or tournaments? We'll sharpen the details that turn close games into wins.

included: A quick check-in on your goals and what you want to work on that day
Hands-on technique coaching with lots of live-ball reps
Simple, memorable takeaways you can use in your very next game
Loaner paddles available if you don't have your own yet [confirm this is true]
includedNote: Based in Walnut Creek, with lessons held at courts around the greater East Bay. [Add specific court names/addresses once confirmed.]
